subject: BENCH_AB_R2 exactly as frozen (protocol sha256 09ab58db864683c26d05141d7e63f925fa0342e1d5880c10a0337272311eb7cb), $500 = Book A $250 + Book B $250. Same code path as OOS_2026_09_10 (sha256 773772ccb98106d874bffd4ddf22f296a9e1a225db5ddfccce69c5d586ab0aba).
method: Each run recomputes the full forward window from the frozen warmup (2024-08-01) on checksumed Binance archives (monthly where published, daily otherwise) and public REST funding; only complete UTC days are scored. A previously scored day that changes is reported as a data revision.
monitoring_policy_amendment: v2 adopted 2026-10-28 after one forward day and before any eligibility decision; strategy, costs and data are unchanged. The amendment only prevents a trivially positive result from being labelled ON_TRACK.

status_rules.BREACH_STOP: stress max drawdown > 10% of $500: stop paper-forward, no capital; review required
status_rules.DATA_REVISED: a previously scored day changed; investigate before interpreting the run
status_rules.BELOW_EXPECTATION: after >= 30 forward days: stress PnL <= 0, realized dollars/day below 50% of the $0.14 reference, or after 90 days fewer than half of calendar months positive
status_rules.OBSERVE: 30-89 days, positive and at least 50% of reference; still ineligible for promotion
status_rules.ON_TRACK: >= 90 days, positive, at least 50% of reference, at least half of calendar months positive, no revisions and no drawdown breach
status_rules.INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 30 forward days; status is informational only

promotion: Composite Book A+B promotion is blocked while Book B violates the 0.5% portfolio open-risk limit. Any future Book A-only canary requires a separately frozen protocol, >= 90 forward days ON_TRACK, DSR >= 0.5 and the execution-readiness checklist.
disclosure: Paper-forward replay on archived market data; no orders are placed.
